verdicts.title: A Note on Entropy of Delone Sets
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this note we present that the patch counting entropy can be obtained as a limit and investigate which sequences of compact sets are suitable to define this quantity. We furthermore present a geometric definition of patch counting entropy for Delone sets of infinite local complexity and that the patch counting entropy of a Delone set equals the topological entropy of the corresponding Delone dynamical system.
